name: regclient-manifest-dependency-graphs-and-376d
instr:
Let callers inspect a manifest's direct descriptor relationships and collect a complete image reachability graph without media-type assertions or custom traversal. Expose the same deterministic graph through the library, templates, and a new regctl manifest graph subcommand while preserving existing manifest operations.

Every supported Docker schema 1, Docker schema 2, and OCI manifest representation reports caller-isolated dependencies in source order with accurate config, layer, child, subject, artifact-blob, and referrer roles, preserving descriptor metadata and reflecting only successful mutations. A bodyless manifest retains its established manifest-not-set error instead of appearing dependency-free. Graph collection preserves roots, descriptor-addressed nodes, distinct role-bearing edges, positions, cycles, and unresolved dependencies, fetching each descriptor at most once while retaining every relationship. Cycles and shared descendants terminate deterministically without hiding other reachable branches, and cancellation stops further retrieval, returns the context error, and preserves completed observations. Registry and OCI-directory traversal retain backend descriptor identity, classify missing children consistently, and optionally expand subjects and referrers without changing or duplicating the root.
